# History search (HISTORY_SEARCH=on) packages: LangChain retrieval, Postgres
# drivers, pgvector, and the local ONNX embedding model's runtime. Installed
# ONLY when the image is built with the build arg HISTORY=1, after
# constraints.txt's packages:
#   pip install --require-hashes --no-deps -r /tmp/requirements-history.txt
# Every package of the closure is listed here (so --no-deps is safe), except
# the ones constraints.txt already pins at the same version (pydantic,
# requests, anyio, httpx2, certifi, ...). tokenizers is listed WITHOUT its
# declared dependency huggingface-hub (and hf_xet, fsspec, ...): importing
# tokenizers never loads it, and this code downloads the model itself.
#
# Generated 24 Nov 2026 on Python 3.12 by a real resolve against the image's
# pins, limited to releases uploaded at least two weeks earlier:
#   pip install --dry-run --ignore-installed --report r.json \
#     --platform manylinux_2_28_x86_64 --platform manylinux2014_x86_64 \
#     --python-version 3.12 --implementation cp --only-binary=:all: \
#     --target /tmp/t --uploaded-prior-to 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z \
#     -c constraints.txt langchain-core langchain-classic langchain-postgres \
#     onnxruntime numpy "psycopg[binary]" pgvector
# (macosx arm64 resolves to the same set), then tokenizers==0.23.3 added by
# hand, and for each pin the sha256 of every cp312/abi3/py3 wheel PyPI lists
# for manylinux and macOS (PyPI JSON API). Regenerate the same way when
# bumping; keep langchain-postgres' caps (pgvector<0.4, psycopg<4) in mind.
#
# Where things live in LangChain 1.x (checked on these wheels):
#   langchain-core      Embeddings, BaseRetriever, Document, BaseCrossEncoder
#   langchain-classic   EnsembleRetriever, ContextualCompressionRetriever,
#                       CrossEncoderReranker (the slim `langchain` 1.x package
#                       has no retrievers and pulls langgraph: not used)
#   langchain-postgres  PGVectorStore + PGEngine (v2; the older PGVector class
#                       is deprecated since 0.0.14), HNSW index, HybridSearchConfig
